verified: Same rules as the Perdix 2 (Petrel 3 Recreational manual Rev C p.26-27, p.56); Tec page row rules (Technical manual Rev B p.24-25)

CC pages: centre row with the internal setpoint between the two transmitters, or the three cell PPO2s (Technical manual Rev B p.10, p.13); CC / BO mode label, BO on a yellow box (p.14, p.37); cells yellow when out of the ±20 % vote, red below 0.4 / above 1.6 (p.57, p.67); loop PPO2 limits 0.40 / 1.60 and DilPO2 0.19 / 1.65 (p.18, p.81)

Info pages: the main screen with its bottom row replaced by one info screen - AI (T1 & GTR/SAC, and T1, T2 & GTR/SAC on a sidemount dive), MOD / MAX / PPO2, TEMP / CONSERV / CNS, GF99 / SurGF / CEIL, BATTERY, PRESSURE mBar SURF / NOW, DATE / CLOCK (Petrel 3 Rec manual Rev C p.15 (row figure), p.16-20)
Gauge page: large depth and dive time, MAX / STOPWATCH, AVG, temperature, clock (Petrel 3 Rec manual Rev C p.33)
assumed: Skin geometry from the Petrel 3 figures
CC (setpoint) on a bailout shows the PPO2 in the setpoint's place, as the Perdix 3 does (its PDF p.87); the Petrel manual pictures BO only with cells
Transmitter labels and pressures come from the log's first and second tank (a Petrel names them D1 / O2 by the diver's setup)
Info and gauge positions measured from the manual's figures and set on the main page's skin
Gauge STOPWATCH shows the dive time: a log records no stopwatch start or reset
Info screens are shown in full, without the 10 s timeout; the date and clock are the log's own time (24 h)
Info pages draw the photo's info-row divider full width, as the info-screen figure shows it
not_shown: VOTING FAILED alternating with the readings (p.67)
Millivolts and stack-timer info screens (p.17, p.21)
Info screens LAST DIVE (surface only), Compass (no heading in a log), TISSUES, DET / Δ+5 / @+5 / TTS (what-if values not computed), SERIAL NO / VERSION
CONSERV level name (Low / Med / High) above the GF pair, and the battery type / nominal voltage beside BATTERY: not in the logs
Gauge page: no notification row and no resettable average (deco is not tracked in gauge mode)
notes._about: What this template reproduces of the real screen and what it does not; manual pages in hud_rules_sources.md
